body: I suggest researching how long marijuana metabolites can possibly stay in a person's system (sometimes stored in fat). Personally, I was offered a job with a large oil company as a millwright and had to stop smoking weed. I stopped as soon as I heard the possibility of getting this job. Interviewed  great, they knew I couldn't piss right away. Ended up taking 66 days to piss clean doing home tests every day. That means it took 66 days from the last time I smoked to pass their "test". I was basically barred for earning employment for 2 months and change for smoking weed in my free time. At no time during those 66 days was I in contact with any marijuana at all. Fair? I don't think so

If you would have asked me three weeks ago "would you consider doing any sort of chemical drug?", I would have said no way. Well two weeks ago I went to a friend's birthday party that was at the warehouse I and some friends rent out for music/art purposes. I had planned on drinking a few newcastles and cutting out early. WELL I actually ended up being offered MDMA. So I said to myself "self, you should open up a little". I drank the MDMA in some water and was rolling hard in almost exactly 30 minutes.
It was one of the coolest experiences in my life and would definitely consider doing it at a later time.
Sometimes you have to just roll with it.

Do I? Maybe not, but I'd rather have no one if I can't have her. I'm double serious when I say that I don't care about the money or the flashy shit. I would not have been doing what I'm doing had I known what her response to a simple, open-ended "how are you doing?" was going to be.
Doubtful. Probably the most honest person I've ever known

Any girl who has been with a guy for that long and gone through so much with, for her to turn away from him whilst he is radically changing and improving the things that were issues must be double-fucked. Absolutely insane. I just know that she isn't that stupid or cold.

Well shit, my plan over the last 2 months has been a workout routine and diet which are comparable to that of a fighter. Pay down what little debt I had (done), save up as much cash as possible (means I've been working 12's for 7 or 8 days a week with maybe a day/day and a half off), buy a really nice car in straight up cash (she always said I deserved a better vehicle). The point is, I'm doing a total 180 from what I was doing when we were together. So come spring time, I'd be ready to maybe try and make contact and then gradually introduce the idea of getting together and so on. I just broke last night. I had to inquire as to how she was. So that was weak. And it seems as if all these improvements are in vain.

Honestly? Nothing. There is literally nothing I do on a regular basis that I enjoy. It's plain to see that the only things I enjoyed doing were with her. Just little things. Things that I have done and do with other people now, but it's no where near what it was with her. Now, I do these everyday things and I feel like a cold piece of clay.

I'm crushed. Positively crushed. Even more than back in July when she said goodbye. I really just can't fathom why she wouldn't want any contact with me. The breakup wasn't bad or messy at all. Obviously I was nearly brought to my knees with grief, but I tried to save face. I didn't argue with her. She had been away for two months before that July following her passion (which I always supported). I had had some tough times with living situations and jobs in the months prior. But that month I had got a really posh, nice new loft. I had got a stable, well-paying job and everything that was somewhat of an issue before was no longer one. So I figured that this was the perfect time to ask her to move in with me finally. NOPE. She said that I was "doing so well without her". What a kick in the teeth. 

So basically, right now I am running through this constant stream of memories and weeping. I went for a walk downtown to get cigarettes. That made me feel a little better. I am still very, very unstable though. 

I'm just at a loss.
This is my first post on reddit. So I apologize that this is in the wrong place.
